arxiv-2011-07731.title: The extension of linear inequality method for generalised rational Chebyshev approximation to approximation by general quasilinear functions.
arxiv-2011-07731.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by . In this paper we demonstrate that a well known linear inequality method developed for rational Chebyshev approximation is equivalent to the application of the bisection method used in quasiconvex optimisation. Although this correspondence is not surprising, it naturally connects rational and generalised rational Chebyshev approximation problems with modern developments in the area of quasiconvex functions and therefore offers more theoretical and computational tools for solving this problem.

arxiv-2111-09992.title: The Thousand-Pulsar-Array programme on MeerKAT VII: Polarisation properties of pulsars in the Magellanic Clouds 2021 The Thousand-Pulsar-Array programme on MeerKAT VII: Polarisation properties of pulsars in the Magellanic Clouds – References
arxiv-2111-09992.creator: S. Johnston, A. Parthasarathy, R. A. Main, J. P. Ridley, B. S. Koribalski, M. Bailes, S. J. Buchner, M. Geyer, A. Karastergiou, M. J. Keith, M. Kramer, M. Serylak, R. M. Shannon, R. Spiewak, V. Venkatraman Krishnan
arxiv-2111-09992.description: Abstract The Magellanic Clouds are the only external galaxies known to host radio pulsars. The dispersion and rotation measures of pulsars in the Clouds can aid in understanding their structure, and studies of the pulsars themselves can point to potential differences between them and their Galactic counterparts.

arxiv-2111-13344.title: Diffusion approximations in population genetics and the rate of Muller’s ratchet
arxiv-2111-13344.creator: Camila Bräutigam, Matteo Smerlak
arxiv-2111-13344.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Camila Bräutigam, Matteo Smerlak. Diffusion theory is a central tool of modern population genetics, yielding simple expressions for fixation probabilities and other quantities that are not easily derived from the underlying Wright-Fisher model. Unfortunately, the textbook derivation of diffusion equations as scaling limits requires evolutionary parameters (selection coefficients, mutation rates) to scale like the inverse population size—a severe restriction that does not always reflect biological reality.

arxiv-2206-13145.title: A Mountain-pass Theorem in Hyperbolic Space and Its Application
arxiv-2206-13145.creator: Junfu Yao
arxiv-2206-13145.description: Abstract . We develop a min-max theory for certain complete minimal hypersurfaces in hyperbolic space. In particular, we show that given two strictly stable minimal hypersurfaces that are both asymptotic to the same ideal boundary, there is a new one trapped between the two.

arxiv-2207-07255.title: Modeling Non-Cooperative Dialogue: Theoretical and Empirical Insights
arxiv-2207-07255.creator: Anthony Sicilia, Tristan Maidment, Pat Healy, Malihe Alikhani
arxiv-2207-07255.description: Abstract Investigating cooperativity of interlocutors is central in studying pragmatics of dialogue. Models of conversation that only assume cooperative agents fail to explain the dynamics of strategic conversations. Thus, we investigate the ability of agents to identify non-cooperative interlocutors while completing a concurrent visual-dialogue task.

arxiv-2303-04220.title: PACMan2: Next Steps in Proposal Review Management Facilities: Hubble Space Telescope , James Webb Space Telescope Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , Scikit-learn ( Pedregosa et al. 2011 ) , spaCy ( Honnibal et al. 2020 )
arxiv-2303-04220.creator: Louis-Gregory Strolger, Jamila Pegues, Tegan King, Nathan Miles, Michelle Ramsahoye, Keith Ceruti II, Brett Blacker, I. Neill Reid
arxiv-2303-04220.description: Abstract With the start of a new Great Observatories era, there is renewed concern that the demand for these forefront facilities, through proposal pressure, will exceed conventional peer-review management’s capacity for ensuring an unbiased and efficient selection. There is need for new methods, strategies, and tools to facilitate those reviews.

arxiv-2303-13277.title: SINE: Semantic-driven Image-based NeRF Editing with Prior-guided Editing Field
arxiv-2303-13277.creator: Chong Bao, Yinda Zhang, Bangbang Yang, Tianxing Fan, Zesong Yang, Hujun Bao, Guofeng Zhang, Zhaopeng Cui
arxiv-2303-13277.description: Abstract Despite the great success in 2D editing using user-friendly tools, such as Photoshop, semantic strokes, or even text prompts, similar capabilities in 3D areas are still limited, either relying on 3D modeling skills or allowing editing within only a few categories.

arxiv-2305-19075.title: Language-Conditioned Imitation Learning with Base Skill Priors under Unstructured Data
arxiv-2305-19075.creator: Hongkuan Zhou, Zhenshan Bing, Xiangtong Yao, Xiaojie Su, Chenguang Yang, Kai Huang, Alois Knoll
arxiv-2305-19075.description: Abstract The growing interest in language-conditioned robot manipulation aims to develop robots capable of understanding and executing complex tasks, with the objective of enabling robots to interpret language commands and manipulate objects accordingly. While language-conditioned approaches demonstrate impressive capabilities for addressing tasks in familiar environments, they encounter limitations in adapting to unfamiliar environment settings.

arxiv-2310-18621.title: Hamiltonian formulation of the RS model and field mixing
arxiv-2310-18621.creator: Qi Chen Kaixun Tu Qing Wang, [5mm] Department of Physics, Tsinghua University, Beijing 100084, China
arxiv-2310-18621.description: Abstract While neutrino oscillations have led to attention and research on field mixing arising from quadratic interactions, the field mixing inherent in clothed particles is more fundamental, serving as a significant source of complexity and non-perturbative challenges in quantum field theory.

arxiv-2401-06065.title: Suppressed Kondo screening in two-dimensional altermagnets
arxiv-2401-06065.creator: G. S. Diniz, E. Vernek
arxiv-2401-06065.description: Abstract We have studied the Kondo effect of a spin-1/2 impurity coupled to a two-dimensional altermagnet host material. To attain the low-temperature many-body Kondo physics of the system, we have performed a numerical renormalization group calculations that allows us to access the spectral properties of the system at zero temperature.

arxiv-2411-17011.title: MOLPIPx: an end-to-end differentiable package for permutationally invariant polynomials in Python and Rust
arxiv-2411-17011.creator: Manuel S. Drehwald, Asma Jamali, Rodrigo A. Vargas-Hernández
arxiv-2411-17011.description: Abstract In this work, we present MOLPIPx, a versatile library designed to seamlessly integrate Permutationally Invariant Polynomials (PIPs) with modern machine learning frameworks, enabling the efficient development of linear models, neural networks, and Gaussian process models. These methodologies are widely employed for parameterizing potential energy surfaces across diverse molecular systems.

arxiv-2502-07994.title: The PLATO Multiple Star Working Group (MSWG) Volume: NN
arxiv-2502-07994.creator: J. Southworth \orcid 0000-0002-3807-3198, P.F.L. Maxted \orcid 0000-0003-3794-1317
arxiv-2502-07994.description: Abstract The PLATO mission is scheduled for launch in December 2026. It is an ESA M-class mission designed to find small planets around bright stars via the transit technique. The light curves it obtains will be wonderful for other science goals, among which is the study of binary and multiple stars.

arxiv-2504-11010.title: New Constructions of Binary Cyclic Codes with Both Relatively Large Minimum Distance and Dual Distance
arxiv-2504-11010.creator: Lingqi Zheng, Weijun Fang, Rongxing Qiu
arxiv-2504-11010.description: Abstract Binary cyclic codes are worth studying due to their applications and theoretical importance. It is an important problem to construct an infinite family of cyclic codes with large minimum distance d d and dual distance d ⟂ d^{\perp} .

arxiv-2510-16229.title: C/N 0 Analysis-Based GPS Spoofing Detection with Variable Antenna Orientations
arxiv-2510-16229.creator: Vienna Li 1 , Justin Villa 2 , Dan Diessner 2 , Jayson Clifford 2 , Laxima Niure Kandel 2
arxiv-2510-16229.description: Abstract GPS spoofing poses a growing threat to aviation by falsifying satellite signals and misleading aircraft navigation systems. This paper demonstrates a proof-of-concept spoofing detection strategy based on analyzing satellite Carrier-to-Noise Density Ratio (C/N 0 ) variation during controlled static antenna orientations.

arxiv-2511-08058.title: Clean up your Mesh! Part 1: Plane and simplex Journal: rsta
arxiv-2511-08058.creator: Steven De Keninck 1, Martin Roelfs 2, Leo Dorst 3 and David Eelbode 4
arxiv-2511-08058.description: Abstract We revisit the geometric foundations of mesh representation through the lens of Plane-based Geometric Algebra (PGA), questioning its efficiency and expressiveness for discrete geometry. We find how k k -simplices (vertices, edges, faces, …) and k k -complexes (point clouds, line complexes, meshes, …) can be written compactly as joins of vertices and their sums, respectively.

arxiv-2512-14993.title: Efficient Nudged Elastic Band Method using Neural Network Bayesian Algorithm Execution
arxiv-2512-14993.creator: Pranav Kakhandiki, Sathya Chitturi, Daniel Ratner, Sean Gasiorowski
arxiv-2512-14993.description: Abstract The discovery of a minimum energy pathway (MEP) between metastable states is crucial for scientific tasks including catalyst and biomolecular design. However, the standard nudged elastic band (NEB) algorithm requires hundreds to tens of thousands of compute-intensive simulations, making applications to complex systems prohibitively expensive.

pmc-11511516.title: A Novel Wearable Sensor for Measuring Respiration Continuously and in Real Time
pmc-11511516.creator: Amjad Ali, Yang Wei, Yomna Elsaboni, Jack Tyson, Harry Akerman, Alexander I. R. Jackson, Rod Lane, Daniel Spencer, Neil M. White
pmc-11511516.description: In this work, a flexible textile-based capacitive respiratory sensor, based on a capacitive sensor structure, that does not require direct skin contact is designed, optimised, and evaluated using both computational modelling and empirical measurements. In the computational study, the geometry of the sensor was examined.

pmc-11533592.title: Synthesis, spectral analysis, and DFT studies of the novel pyrano[3,2-c] quinoline-based 1,3,4-thiadiazole for enhanced solar cell performance
pmc-11533592.creator: Ibtisam Alali, Magdy A. Ibrahim, N. Roushdy, Al-Shimaa Badran, Alaa Muqbil Alsirhani, A.A.M. Farag
pmc-11533592.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In this study, we synthesized a novel compound, 3-(5-amino-1,3,4-thiadiazol-2-yl)-6-ethyl-4-hydroxy-2H-pyrano[3,2-c]quinoline-2,5(6H)-dione (ATEHPQ), through a condensation reaction between 6-ethyl-4-hydroxy-2,5-dioxo-5,6-dihydro-2H-pyrano [3,2-c]quinoline-3-carboxaldehyde and thiosemicarbazide, followed by oxidative cyclization. We characterized ATEHPQ using elemental analysis, IR, 1H and 13C NMR spectroscopy, and mass spectrometry. Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations with the B3LYP/6–311++G(d,p) basis set were employed to optimize the molecular geometry and analyze global reactivity descriptors, including HOMO-LUMO energies. The Molecular Electrostatic Potential (MEP) map was used to identify reactive sites, and drug-likeness studies indicated potential pharmaceutical applications.

pmc-11655584.title: NCF-1 plays a pivotal role in the survival of adenocarcinoma cells of pancreatic and gastric origins
pmc-11655584.creator: Chiemi Furuya-Ikude, Akane Kitta, Naoko Tomonobu, Yoshihiro Kawasaki, Masakiyo Sakaguchi, Eisaku Kondo
pmc-11655584.description: Reactive oxygen species (ROS) play a pivotal biological role in cells, with ROS function differing depending on cellular conditions and the extracellular environment. Notably, ROS act as cytotoxic factors to eliminate infectious pathogens or promote cell death under cellular stress, while also facilitating cell growth (via ROS-sensing pathways) by modifying gene expression.

pmc-12537357.title: Global, regional, and national burden of gastric cancer attributable to diet high in sodium from 1990 to 2021
pmc-12537357.creator: Chao Ma, Bing Yan, Ge Li, Yongsheng Jiang
pmc-12537357.description: BackgroundThis study, based on the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2021 database, investigates the global and regional burden of gastric cancer attributable to diet high in sodium (GC-DHIS) from 1990 to 2021 and projects trends through 2045, with the aim of providing evidence to inform public health policymaking.MethodsData were obtained from GBD 2021, covering 204 countries and territories.

pmc-13357767.title: Reproducible Data Analysis With R in Laboratory Hematology
pmc-13357767.creator: Amrom E. Obstfeld
pmc-13357767.description: Laboratory hematology generates large, complex datasets that increasingly exceed the capabilities of traditional spreadsheet‐based analytical workflows. Despite their familiarity, spreadsheets obscure analytical logic, encourage manual data manipulation, and lack durable records of analytical steps, limiting transparency, auditability, and reproducibility. These limitations present specific challenges in clinical laboratory settings subject to regulatory oversight.

pmc-13420658.title: Dilated and Noncompaction Cardiomyopathy in a Pediatric Patient With Maternal CASZ1 Variant
pmc-13420658.creator: Lauren Sekiguchi, Michael Nguyen-Truong, Kristy Y Lin, David P Chan
pmc-13420658.description: BackgroundThe CASZ1 gene expresses a cardiomyocyte transcription factor implicated in early heart morphogenesis. CASZ1 variants have been associated with the development of dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) and noncompaction cardiomyopathy (NCCM), although reported cases are limited.Case SummaryA 3-month-old boy with no family history of cardiomyopathy presented with a murmur and persistent tachycardia.

pmc-13454943.title: Protocol for In Vitro Activation of Jurkat E6-1 Cells Using Recombinant Human Galectin
pmc-13454943.creator: Ruei-De Yan, Ling Mao, Yi-Jing Chen, Chien-Hui Lo, Yi-Chang Liu
pmc-13454943.description: Surface receptor engagement governs T-cell activation. Since these surface receptors undergo extensive glycosylation, lectin-mediated crosslinking of these glycosylated surface receptors has the potential to modulate signaling. Here, we systematically evaluate the abilities of recombinant human galectins in triggering immune responses.

pmc-13554001.title: FLT3-mutated AML: standards of care and ongoing investigation
pmc-13554001.creator: Ly V. Do, Jessica J. Jorgensen, Kieran D. Sahasrabudhe
pmc-13554001.description: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is characterized by the rapid, unchecked clonal proliferation of myeloid precursor cells. It is the most common type of acute leukemia in adults and exhibits significant molecular heterogeneity. FLT3 mutations are among the most common and well-described genetic mutations in AML; they worsen overall survival and increase the relapse rate.

pmc-13631258.title: L-2-Hydroxyglutarate sensitizes ferroptosis through ATF3/CHAC1-mediated glutathione degradation in hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-13631258.creator: Caixia Xi, Junfeng Pang, Mohammad Oliaeimotlagh, Rui Mao, Wenbo Zhi, Kimya Jones, Tianxiang Hu, Huidong Shi, Ande Satyanarayana, Anatolij Horuzsko, Chunhong Yan, Nahid F Mivechi, Xingguo Zhu
pmc-13631258.description: Ferroptosis is an iron-dependent form of regulated cell death driven by lipid peroxidation and glutathione (GSH) depletion and represents a therapeutic vulnerability in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). While canonical ferroptosis regulation centers on cystine uptake and GPX4-mediated GSH utilization, the endogenous metabolic pathways governing ferroptosis sensitivity in liver tumors remain incompletely understood.

pmc-13716434.title: Evaluating Knowledge, Attitudes and Practices regarding Dental Erosion among Tunisian Dental Partitioners.
pmc-13716434.creator: Linda Ayedi, Hanen Boukhris, Taha Yessine, Cyrine Jebali, Sihem Hajjeji, Nouha Mghirbi, Hayet Hajjemi, Souha Ben Youssef
pmc-13716434.description: Introduction. Dental erosion is characterized by the irreversible loss of tooth structure due to non-bacterial acids. Despite its prevalence, the level of awareness and understanding among dental practitioners remains unclear, particularly in Tunisia.Aim. This study aimed to assess the Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices of dental practitioners in Tunisia regarding the causes, risk factors, symptoms, and management of dental erosion.Methods.
